title: Avoid holding the global state mutex through standalone mailbox SQLite commits
outcome: Standalone mailbox sends preserve the explicit native-creation/unbound namespace fence without holding the global state mutex across SQLite fsync on the disabled-by-default path.
acceptance: A reviewed admission/fencing design preserves exact native identities, deletion/recreation and binding-versus-append serialization.
Standalone SQLite commit can proceed without blocking unrelated state-lock users; a deterministic regression covers the apply cut.
Exact-input checks and independent review cover the revised fence.
